highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.116.0 updates to Skia m116 with broad API, WebAssembly, and platform improvements.
highlights_body: It adds modern interop and span APIs, improves Blazor and desktop views, and refreshes the graphics engine for current .NET workloads.

breaking.title: Legacy platform APIs updated
breaking.body: Several obsolete and platform-specific APIs changed as part of the m116 update. Review the API diff and migrate to the current view and rendering APIs.

bullets.detail: Refreshes the bundled renderer and native dependencies with the Chrome m116 engine release.

bullets.lead: Drawing, image, and span APIs expanded
bullets.detail: Adds span overloads, SKPicture and Skottie APIs, SKBlender, raw shaders, and additional graphics interop support.
Improves WebAssembly compatibility and adds or updates accelerated graphics views across supported desktop and mobile platforms.
